definitions.explanation: small pieces of paper with a re-adherable adhesive strip on the back, used for marking pages, leaving messages, or organizing information

notes:
Combines ⟦{付箋|ふせん}→付箋：08245_fusen⟧ (tag, label, sticky note) and {紙|し} (paper). In everyday conversation, ⟦{付箋|ふせん}→付箋：08245_fusen⟧ alone is more commonly used, but {付箋紙|ふせんし} is the more precise term found on product packaging and in formal contexts. The brand name ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧・イット (Post-it) is also widely recognized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付箋紙|ふせんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to stick a note
- {付箋紙|ふせんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧: to peel off a sticky note
- {付箋紙|ふせんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write on a sticky note
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧{付箋紙|ふせんし}: colored sticky notes
